events.sql:
SELECT 
  t1.userregistry AS user_id, 
  t1.nicklabel AS nickname, 
  t2.spendusd AS total_support 
FROM 
  fans AS t1 
  JOIN membershipandspending AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.memberfanpivot 
ORDER BY 
  total_support DESC;
